zh: Biodesign Challenge 生物设计挑战赛
desc_en: Summit winners and finalists of the Biodesign Challenge (2016–2025), the international competition in which art and design students work with biologists for a year and present at MoMA and Parsons in New York.
desc_zh: Biodesign Challenge（2016–2025）峰会的获奖与入围作品。这一国际竞赛让艺术设计学生与生物学家合作一整年，并在纽约 MoMA 和帕森斯设计学院展示成果。

desc_en: Bio and more-than-human grand prizes, honorary mentions and nominations of the S+T+ARTS Prize, the European Commission's prize for art–science–technology collaboration run by Ars Electronica since 2016.
desc_zh: S+T+ARTS 奖中与生命、生物及“超越人类”相关的大奖、荣誉提名和提名作品。该奖由欧盟委员会设立、自 2016 年起由电子艺术节（Ars Electronica）主办，表彰艺术、科学与技术的合作。

desc_en: Bio-based international winners, national winners and runners-up and International Top 20 projects of the James Dyson Award for student designers and engineers.
desc_zh: 詹姆斯·戴森设计奖中以生物或生物基材料为核心的国际冠军、各国冠军与亚军以及国际 20 强项目。该奖面向学生设计师与工程师。

zh: 全球变革奖（H&M 基金会）
desc_en: Bio-based and biotech winners of the H&M Foundation's Global Change Award for circular fashion innovation, 2016–2026.
desc_zh: H&M 基金会“全球变革奖”（2016–2026）中与生物材料和生物技术相关的获奖项目。该奖表彰循环时尚创新。

desc_en: Winners and finalists of the Earthshot Prize that work with living organisms, ecosystems or bio-based materials (2021–2024).
desc_zh: 地球奖（2021–2024）中与活体生物、生态系统或生物基材料合作的获奖与入围项目。

en: INDEX: Design to Improve Life Award
desc_en: Bio-based winners and finalists of the biennial INDEX Award from The Index Project in Copenhagen.
desc_zh: 哥本哈根 The Index Project 两年一度的 INDEX 奖中以生物为基础的获奖与入围作品。

en: Beazley Designs of the Year (Design Museum)
zh: Beazley 年度设计（伦敦设计博物馆）
desc_en: Nominees and winners of the Design Museum London's Beazley Designs of the Year (2019–2020 editions) that work with living organisms or bio-based materials.
desc_zh: 伦敦设计博物馆 Beazley 年度设计（2019–2020 届）中与活体生物或生物基材料相关的提名与获奖作品。

desc_en: Winners, highly commended and shortlisted bio-based projects of the Dezeen Awards (2019–2025).
desc_zh: Dezeen 设计奖（2019–2025）中以生物为基础的获奖、高度推荐和入围项目。

desc_en: Bio-based finalists and winners of the Lexus Design Award for emerging designers (2014–2023).
desc_zh: 雷克萨斯设计奖（2014–2023）中以生物为基础的入围与获奖作品。该奖面向新锐设计师。

desc_en: Winners and nominees of the Dutch Design Awards (Eindhoven) that design with living organisms, grown materials or other species.
desc_zh: 荷兰设计奖（埃因霍温）中与活体生物、生长材料或其他物种一起设计的获奖与提名作品。

desc_en: Bio-based winners and finalists of the Terra Carta Design Lab, the Sustainable Markets Initiative's competition with the Royal College of Art (2022 and 2024 editions).
desc_zh: Terra Carta 设计实验室（2022 与 2024 届）中以生物为基础的获奖与入围项目。该竞赛由可持续市场倡议与皇家艺术学院等院校合办。

desc_en: Winners, fellows and nominees of the Dutch New Material Award (2014–2018) and its predecessor the DOEN Material Prize (2009–2013) made from plants, fungi, animals, microbes or the human body.
desc_zh: 荷兰新材料奖（2014–2018）及其前身 DOEN 材料奖（2009–2013）中由植物、真菌、动物、微生物或人体材料制成的获奖、驻留与提名作品。

en: Green Product Award & Green Concept Award
zh: 绿色产品奖与绿色概念奖
desc_en: Bio-based winners and finalists of the Berlin-based Green Product Award and its student track, the Green Concept Award (2021–2026).
desc_zh: 柏林绿色产品奖及其学生赛道绿色概念奖（2021–2026）中以生物为基础的获奖与入围作品。

zh: 全球毕业展（迪拜设计周）
desc_en: Graduate projects working with living organisms selected for the Global Grad Show at Dubai Design Week (2015–2021).
desc_zh: 入选迪拜设计周“全球毕业展”（2015–2021）的、与活体生物合作的毕业设计项目。

zh: Falling Walls 艺术与科学年度突破
desc_en: Winners and finalists of the Art & Science category of the Falling Walls Science Breakthroughs of the Year (Berlin) that work with living organisms and ecosystems.
desc_zh: 柏林 Falling Walls 年度科学突破奖“艺术与科学”类别中，与活体生物和生态系统合作的获奖与入围作品。

desc_en: Projects from iGEM, the International Genetically Engineered Machine competition, that approached synthetic biology as design, art or public communication (2009–2014).
desc_zh: 国际基因工程机器大赛（iGEM，2009–2014）中把合成生物学作为设计、艺术或公共传播来开展的项目。
